b: Log in with Google or email. New accounts get {TRIAL} days of free Pro.
Set your user name in My account (shown in chat and on shared templates; each name is unique).
Tap English / Bahasa Melayu to change the language.
Your settings, brand styles and own templates follow your account to any phone (videos stay on each phone).
Main phone: tap Director. Other phones: tap Camera and type the Studio ID or scan the QR.
Tap a camera at the bottom to show that angle. Pinch to zoom, tap to focus.
🔄 on the picture: front / back camera. Long-press a camera: torch, brightness, auto focus.
All phones on the same Wi-Fi works best.
For computers only (Chrome, Edge or Firefox).
On the computer open promulticam.web.app → Camera → type the Studio ID → Send screen.
The screen becomes an angle you can switch to, like a camera.
Start Recording → Pause / Resume anytime. Recording keeps a steady 30 fps.
Continue a saved video to add more to it, with no frozen picture at the join.
Turn the phone (also upside down): the screen follows after a moment, the video format you chose stays.
🎨 Look: Supermassive (bright, sharp, HD) and 12 more. Layout: Full, Split, Small frame.
Auto switch angles every few seconds, switch effect (12 or 🎲 Auto random), recording fade in/out.
Each setting shows a small moving example.
6 brand styles: logo, title, price, phone. Tap a style to edit with a live preview.
Show each part Always, Hidden, or for some seconds and repeat — it fades in and out softly.
All recordings are here: play, share, delete, Import from the gallery.
Tap Video & Photos or Drafts to edit. Home → Template opens the templates.
Add videos/photos from the gallery (albums at the top). Drag the timeline; tools act on the clip under the white line.
✂ Cut: split, freeze, duration, duplicate, delete. Drag clip edges to trim; long-press to move.
🔁 Replace, ⏩ Speed, 〰 Fade, 🔈 Volume, 🔊 Video sound on/off.
Export: 720p/1080p, 30/60 fps. Drafts save by themselves.
Effects, Filters, Adjust, 16 switches between clips.
◆ Keyframe (zoom/move over time), 🫨 Steady, 🌫 Blur sides, 🎧 Clean sound, ⏪ Reverse.
👤 Remove background (AI): blur, colour, photo or video behind the person.
🎞 Video on top + 🟩 Green screen, 🖼 Overlay photo.
T Text (styles, fonts, animations), 😊 Stickers, 🌸 Decor (petals, bubbles, rain, confetti…).
♪ Audio: built-in music, music library, your phone's music, sound effects, AI voice, 🎙 record voice.
Tap a song → 🥁 Cut to beat to change clips on the beat.
Many free templates by group (Super, Food, Sales, Wishes, Life, Music, Community).
Tap one → empty boxes appear → tap each box or 📥 Fill all. Change any clip with 🔁 Replace.
Save your own or 🌍 Share with everyone. Using templates needs Pro; everyone can look.
Tap 💬 on the home page to talk with other users. Needs a user name.
Be kind: rude words are blocked. Long-press your message to delete it.
Basic (free): Director + 1 camera phone, Standard look, 720p, Full layout, editor basics.
Pro: up to 6 cameras, 1080p, all looks & layouts, auto switch & effects, brand styles, templates.
Price: Monthly {MO} · Yearly {YR}. New accounts: {TRIAL} days Pro free.
Pay: Plans → choose → Pay now (online banking / e-wallet). Pro starts once paid. Promo codes accepted.
No auto-charge: renew from Plans before it ends. When Pro ends you go back to Basic; your videos stay.
New versions download by themselves; tap the notification to install. Or Home → App Update.
Need help? About → Support: choose the issue, send a message or a photo (e.g. payment proof).
Director phone: Android 10+, 4 GB RAM, 5 GB free space. Use Device check.
Good light, phones on stands, chargers plugged in for long videos.
Log masuk guna Google atau emel. Akaun baru dapat Pro percuma {TRIAL} hari.
Tetapkan nama pengguna di Akaun saya (dipapar dalam sembang dan templat dikongsi; setiap nama unik).
Tekan English / Bahasa Melayu untuk tukar bahasa.
Tetapan, gaya jenama dan templat anda ikut akaun ke mana-mana telefon (video kekal dalam telefon masing-masing).
Telefon utama: tekan Director. Telefon lain: tekan Camera dan taip ID Studio atau imbas QR.
Tekan kamera di bawah untuk papar sudut itu. Cubit untuk zoom, tekan untuk fokus.
🔄 pada gambar: kamera depan / belakang. Tekan lama kamera: lampu suluh, kecerahan, fokus automatik.
Semua telefon dalam Wi-Fi yang sama paling baik.
Untuk komputer sahaja (Chrome, Edge atau Firefox).
Di komputer buka promulticam.web.app → Camera → taip ID Studio → Send screen.
Skrin jadi satu sudut yang boleh ditukar, sama macam kamera.
Start Recording → Jeda / Sambung bila-bila masa. Rakaman kekal 30 fps.
Sambung video tersimpan untuk tambah lagi, tanpa gambar beku di sambungan.
Pusing telefon (termasuk terbalik): skrin ikut selepas seketika, format video yang dipilih kekal.
🎨 Gaya: Supermassive (terang, tajam, HD) dan 12 lagi. Susun atur: Penuh, Split, Bingkai kecil.
Tukar sudut automatik, kesan tukar (12 atau 🎲 Auto rawak), pudar rakaman awal/akhir.
Setiap tetapan ada contoh bergerak.
6 gaya jenama: logo, tajuk, harga, telefon. Tekan gaya untuk ubah dengan pratonton langsung.
Papar setiap bahagian Sentiasa, Tiada, atau beberapa saat dan ulang — muncul dan hilang perlahan.
Semua rakaman di sini: main, kongsi, padam, Import dari galeri.
Tekan Video & Gambar atau Draf untuk edit. Muka depan → Template buka templat.
Tambah video/gambar dari galeri (album di atas). Tarik timeline; alat bertindak pada klip di bawah garisan putih.
✂ Potong: belah, beku, tempoh, salin, padam. Tarik tepi klip untuk potong; tekan lama untuk alih.
🔁 Tukar, ⏩ Laju, 〰 Pudar, 🔈 Volum, 🔊 Suara video buka/tutup.
Eksport: 720p/1080p, 30/60 fps. Draf disimpan sendiri.
Efek, Filter, Laras, 16 kesan tukar antara klip.
◆ Keyframe (zum/gerak ikut masa), 🫨 Stabil, 🌫 Latar kabur, 🎧 Buang bising, ⏪ Terbalik.
👤 Buang latar (AI): kabur, warna, gambar atau video di belakang orang.
🎞 Video atas + 🟩 Skrin hijau, 🖼 Tindih gambar.
T Teks (gaya, fon, animasi), 😊 Stiker, 🌸 Hiasan (kelopak, gelembung, hujan, konfeti…).
♪ Audio: muzik terbina, pustaka muzik, muzik telefon, kesan bunyi, suara AI, 🎙 rakam suara.
Tekan lagu → 🥁 Ikut rentak untuk tukar klip tepat pada rentak.
Banyak templat percuma ikut kumpulan (Super, Makanan, Jualan, Ucapan, Gaya hidup, Muzik, Komuniti).
Tekan satu → kotak kosong muncul → tekan setiap kotak atau 📥 Isi semua. Tukar mana-mana klip dengan 🔁 Tukar.
Simpan sendiri atau 🌍 Kongsi dengan semua. Guna templat perlu Pro; semua boleh lihat.
Tekan 💬 di muka depan untuk berbual dengan pengguna lain. Perlu nama pengguna.
Berbudi bahasa: perkataan kasar disekat. Tekan lama mesej anda untuk padam.
Asas (percuma): Pengarah + 1 telefon kamera, gaya Standard, 720p, susun atur Penuh, editor asas.
Pro: sehingga 6 kamera, 1080p, semua gaya & susun atur, tukar automatik & kesan, gaya jenama, templat.
Harga: Bulanan {MO} · Tahunan {YR}. Akaun baru: Pro percuma {TRIAL} hari.
Bayar: Plans → pilih → Bayar sekarang (perbankan online / e-dompet). Pro aktif sebaik dibayar. Kod promo boleh guna.
Tiada caj automatik: sambung dari Plans sebelum tamat. Bila Pro tamat, anda kembali ke Asas; video anda kekal.
Versi baru dimuat turun sendiri; tekan notifikasi untuk pasang. Atau muka depan → App Update.
Perlu bantuan? About → Sokongan: pilih jenis masalah, hantar mesej atau gambar (cth. bukti bayaran).
Telefon Pengarah: Android 10+, RAM 4 GB, storan kosong 5 GB. Guna Semak peranti.
Cahaya terang, telefon atas tripod, sambung pengecas untuk video panjang.
